summary: Retest of the HIGH bug from iteration_11 (Kullanıcılar tab hidden until refresh). RESULT: The claimed fix was NOT applied. /api/auth/login STILL returns user object WITHOUT `role`. /app/backend/auth.py line 149 is unchanged from iteration_11 — it still emits `{"id": user["id"], "username": user["username"]}` and omits role. Verified end-to-end: (1) direct curl to /api/auth/login shows no role in response; (2) Playwright flow — cleared localStorage, logged in as serkan/19071987, opened Ayarlar — modal shows only 3 tabs (RENKLER, TEMALAR, HESAP), Kullanıcılar tab absent. Regression: /api/auth/me still returns role=admin (works). Login attempts collection was cleared before test (0 stale entries). No frontend or backend code change has landed for this bug — either the edit was never saved, was reverted by a subsequent save, or was applied to the wrong file.

critical.issue: Response body still omits `role` from user object. Actual response: {token, token_type: 'bearer', user: {id, username}}. Expected: user object to also include role so the frontend can gate admin UI (Kullanıcılar tab) immediately on first login. Fix from iteration_11 was NOT applied — auth.py line 149 unchanged.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab still hidden immediately after fresh login as serkan (admin). Only RENKLER / TEMALAR / HESAP tabs visible in the Ayarlar modal. useAuth().user.role remains undefined because login response has no role. Tab only appears after a page reload triggers /auth/me.

integration_issues.flow: Admin login → open Settings → Kullanıcılar tab
integration_issues.issue: Kullanıcılar tab absent on first login. Requires page refresh to hydrate role from /auth/me. Exactly the same behavior as iteration_11 — no change.

action_items: HIGH: Apply the missing one-line fix in /app/backend/auth.py::login (line ~149). Change `"user": {"id": user["id"], "username": user["username"]}` to `"user": {"id": user["id"], "username": user["username"], "role": user.get("role", "user")}`. Verify with: `curl -s -X POST $BE/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"serkan","password":"19071987"}' | jq .user.role` → should print `admin`.
MEDIUM: Confirm the edit actually persisted this time — the iteration_11 handoff said the fix was applied but it is not in the file. Suggest a `git diff` before declaring done.

rca of the issue: iteration_11 recommended the fix and iteration_12 was queued to verify it, but the code edit did not land in /app/backend/auth.py.
